title: Kicked Warm-Roasted Ananas Argentinian Pancake
description: A low-glycemic-friendly and air-fried jammy argentinian dish featuring an overripe pineapple, vanilla bean, and a touch of cinnamon for a sick-day comfort food.
instructions: Halve the pineapple lengthwise and scoop out the seeds from inside, leaving a thin layer of flesh on each side for structure.
Squeeze the vanilla bean or scrape it with a spoon into the hollowed-out center of the pineapple.
Coat the cut sides of the pineapples in cinnamon powder and place them into the air fryer basket.
Drizzle with palm sugar if using, then sprinkle with extra vanilla seeds if desired.
Air fry for 10 minutes or until golden brown on both sides, flipping halfway through cooking time.
Let cool slightly before serving warm, topped with a dollop of Greek yogurt and fresh mint leaves.
